# How src/retry.js decides when to give up

A failed call to the billing API is tried again only while attempts remain and the error is one a retry can fix.

## 1. The attempt cap comes first

1. Call fails
2. Attempt count checked
3. Stop at 4 attempts

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  s1["Call fails"] --> s2["Attempt count checked"] --> s3["Stop at 4 attempts"]
```

**Takeaway:** once MAX_ATTEMPTS (4) calls have failed, shouldRetry gives up whatever the status code.

## 2. The status code decides the rest

- 429 Too Many Requests: retry
- Other 4xx: give up
- 5xx: retry

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  c["Status code"] --> a["429: retry"]
  c --> b["Other 4xx: give up"]
  c --> d["5xx: retry"]
```

**Takeaway:** a client error other than 429 will fail the same way again, so it is not retried.

## Terms

- **status code**: the number the server sends back to say how the call went.

- src/retry.js
